body:
GNOME COMMANDER
CR 8

XP 3,200
CN Small humanoid
Init +7, Senses Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +1 size, +4 armor)
hp 60 (8d6 +32)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +7

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee dagger +3, 1d3-1 damage
Spells Prepared (CL 8th)

4th–protection from energy (communal), wall of ice
3rd–dispel magic, slow
2nd–glitterdust, invisibility, scorching ray
1st–burning hands, grease, magic missile, obscuring mist, ray of enfeeblement
0th–dancing lights, ghost sound, message, resistance, touch of fatigue

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 16, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 20
Base Atk +3; CMB +4, CMD 14
Feats Improved Initiative, Toughness
